column1: # RNG-word TAINT manifest — the reviewed registry behind scripts/check-rng-taint.sh.
# Companion of scripts/rng-window-manifest.tsv. That registry tracks the VRF-word STORAGE
# identifiers; this one tracks the word once it travels by PARAMETER: every function that
# declares a word-shaped parameter (PARAM rows, subject = the parameter) and every
# cross-contract call that passes a word-shaped identifier (ARG rows, subject = the callee),
# as re-derived from source by scripts/lib/rng_taint_extract.py. The gate keeps this registry
# in exact correspondence with source; the CLASS column is the reviewed judgement.
# Classes: CONSUMER-SEALED (derives an outcome from a word already committed; rationale names
# the commitment point and the frozen inputs) · EXEMPT-ADVANCE (the crank / fulfilment /
# backfill machinery) · PURE-DERIVE (a pure helper mapping a committed word to a value, no actor
# input) · PRODUCER (requests or lands a word) · GATE (readiness read only) · VIEW (off-chain
# read surface) · NOT-RNG (a name collision — the value is not a VRF word).
# One row carries a BY-DESIGN note (the deity's choice among three one-shot boon slots after
# the day's word is public — deity-daily-boon-slots-3, v68 RNGF-LBX-07, LOW): recorded, not
# Columns: CLASS  kind  subject  function  file  rationale
